_comment: The partner profile. Every fact the agent learns lands in one slot. Key slots set profile completeness; when a key slot is empty, its question is what the manager asks next (one per message, lowest ask_rank first). multi: the slot keeps every value; otherwise a newer value replaces the old one. Never store anything in never_store.

slots.label: Goals
slots.question: What are you working toward this year?

slots.label: Clients
slots.question: What kind of clients are you working with most these days?

slots.label: What would help
slots.question: What would make this partnership worth your time?

slots.label: What their clients need
slots.question: When one of your clients needs capital, what's it usually for?

slots.label: Best way to reach them
slots.question: Is text the best way to reach you, or do you prefer a call?

slots.label: Typical deal size
slots.question: Roughly what size are the deals your clients usually need?

slots.label: Where they work
slots.question: Are your clients mostly local, or all over?

slots.label: Best time to reach them
slots.question: When's usually the best time to catch you?

slots.label: What's gotten in the way
slots.question: What's gotten in the way of sending deals lately?

never_store: SSN, EIN or other ID numbers
